title: chore(deps): unpin tinybench and tinyexec
body:
### Description

- closes https://github.com/vitest-dev/vitest/issues/11282

I just noticed that `tinybench` and `tinyexec` were pinned to exact versions from the discussion of https://github.com/vitest-dev/vitest/issues/11282.

It looks like the pinning was done in some old renovate PRs like #10898 and #9958. Since then, they have been already upgraded beyond that pinned version later, but the exact version remained. This PR restores caret ranges and also do some cleanup with catalog and stale release age rule.
